description: Vintage engraving-style sky mural 5056x3392 (3:2, landscape): hot-air balloons in blue-grey and cream stripes, swallows, shooting stars and soft cream clouds on a pale powder-blue sky; calm, dreamy, boyish-neutral. Facts only: the photo cards live in sets (specs/sets/*.json).
